title: Implement scenario section + enforce deliberate card grids
story: As a visitor, I want the scenario section and feature cards to display cleanly at common widths so the site feels intentional and premium.
description: Add the scenario section to the most appropriate page (prefer Why This Is Different). Fix any 4-card sections that currently wrap 3+1 by using deliberate 2×2 or breakpoint-safe 4-up grids.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario section appears on the chosen page and matches site tone.
No 4-card section renders as 3+1 at common desktop widths.
For 4-card sections: either 2×2 at sm+ or 4-up only at xl+ (with 2-up at sm+).
